title: tricostularia zeylanica
intro: Tricostularia zeylanica, commonly known as 'Kurumthotti', is a plant species belonging to the family Arecaceae. It is a medicinal plant used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine, particularly in Sri Lanka, for its numerous health benefits. The plant has been found to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Tricostularia zeylanica include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
